title: Tandem meal planner: monthly price
context: Tandem is a meal-planning app for busy families in France: weekly menus, a shared shopping list and 20-minute recipes. Comparable apps cost 5-10 euros a month.

variants.seed_text:
# Tandem Premium
Plan a week of family dinners in 5 minutes. Weekly menus adapted to your kids' tastes, one shared shopping list, 20-minute recipes.

**7.99 € / month**, cancel anytime, 14-day free trial, no card needed.

# Tandem Premium
Plan a week of family dinners in 5 minutes. Weekly menus adapted to your kids' tastes, one shared shopping list, 20-minute recipes.

**89 € / month**, 12-month minimum commitment, billed annually upfront (1,068 €). No free trial. Cancellation fee: 150 €.

source: synthetic sanity case: the difference is planted and obvious by design
